Sam F (Finance): FYI invoice INV-4647 failed today — card declined at capture. gateway returned 402 / card_declined.
Nora B (Billing): Got it. Any decline_reason in the gateway payload? cvv? postal? 3ds?
Devon S (Support): I pulled the charge:
```
{
  code: 'card_declined',
  decline_code: 'insufficient_funds',
  avs_result: 'N',
  last4: '4242'
}
```
Customer says they updated billing info last week though.
Lina (AE): Customer is HealthGrid Inc — they switched cards two weeks ago. I emailed them a billing link but no response yet. Can we auto-retry?
Sam F (Finance): We normally do 3 automated retries at 6h, 24h, 72h. This was the first attempt. I'll queue retry schedule. If it fails again we'll need a manual outreach.
Nora B (Billing): Please hold on waiving late fees. If retries fail, Sam can approve 1-time courtesy waiver after sales confirms revenue risk.
Devon S (Support): @Lina can you ping the customer with a secure update link? I'll send the portal link now: https://billing.redwood.ai/update-payment?inv=INV-4647 (note: tokenized)
Lina (AE): On it. I'll call them in 30m and DM the link. If they want to pay by wire, do we have instructions ready?
Sam F (Finance): Yes — wire instructions: Account: Redwood Inference LLC, Bank: FirstCloud Bank, IBAN: XX00 1111 2222 3333 4444, Ref: INV-4647. Fill out internal wire approval form afterwards.
Devon S (Support): Adding ops-bot note to thread for accounting: ops-bot: invoice INV-4647 status updated -> payment_failed
ops-bot: invoice INV-4647 status updated -> payment_failed
Nora B (Billing): I'll flag the invoice as "awaiting customer response" and add a comment to collections queue.
Sam F (Finance): If they ask for ACH instead of card/wire, we can do micro-deposit — allow 3 business days. Lina, confirm preference on the call and advise timeline to customer.
Lina (AE): Will do. I'll also ask whether they want us to try the other card on file ending in 9811.
Devon S (Support): Noted. If they give new card details over the phone, we should ask them to enter via billing portal only (PCI). I'll include that in the call script.
Nora B (Billing): After retries complete (or manual payment), I will reconcile and update the ledger. Sam, please confirm if we should suspend service after 5 days of non-payment?
Sam F (Finance): Standard is 7 days for non-enterprise accounts; HealthGrid is mid-market — let's set 7 days. If they escalate, we can extend to 10 with Lina's sign-off.
Lina (AE): Understood. I'll prioritize this call.
Devon S (Support): Closing loop: created support ticket #SUP-8821 and linked to INV-4647.
Sam F (Finance): Thanks all. I'll monitor retry attempts and post updates here.
Nora B (Billing): Thx :thumbsup:
ops-bot: scheduled_retry INV-4647 at +6h
